subject: Dedicated infra qualification & MOP — GridHealth
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated infra qualification & MOP — GridHealth

Anna — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps. This mirrors the Mutual Onboarding Plan (MOP) attached (GridHealth-MAP-v1.pdf).

Key pain points you described:
- High tail latency for interactive clinical QA flows (p95 ~2.2s at peak).
- Regulatory/data isolation requirement: PHI must remain within customer VPC and encrypted at rest.
- Predictable spend — procurement needs a commitment-based option and clear SLA for critical endpoints.

Goals you set:
1) Serve production inference for triage + notes summarization with stable p95 <= 1.2s at 50 RPS sustained.
2) Private/dedicated environment with strict network isolation and customer-managed keys (KMS).
3) A procurement-friendly reserved GPU plan (monthly commit) with clear burst behavior and an SLA we can sign.

Technical qualification notes (high level):
- Workload profile: batching-friendly but latency-sensitive; average prompt length ~450 tokens, KV cache for repeated conversation contexts expected.
- Initial capacity ask you mentioned: equivalent of 8xA100 (or 16xA10s) for initial staging + pilot. 2x burstable nodes for load spikes.
- Isolation: Redwood Private VPC option preferred; acceptable to run control plane out-of-band if needed.

Proposed SLA targets (we discussed):
- 99.95% availability for the dedicated pool (SLA-backed).
- P95 inference latency target: <= 1.2s for the primary endpoint with automatic fallback to a lower-cost model if degraded.
- Incident RTO: 1 hour for critical outages; notifications via PagerDuty/console.

Immediate next steps (action owners & timing):
1) Sean: Send MOP + draft pricing band and reserved commit options (attached: redwood-dedicated-sla-terms.pdf) — by EOD 6/21.
2) Anna/Procurement: Share procurement timeline + PO process and any contract constraints — by 6/25.
3) Stephanie (CDS/security): Schedule security deep-dive (SOC2 evidence, network model, KMS) — target week of 6/28.
4) Vivek (Infra): Provide estimated time to provision dedicated pool and any isolation caveats (disk encryption, VPC peering) — by 6/24.

Please confirm items above and flag any corrections. If this looks right I'll produce the formal quote and a proposed SOW for the pilot phase (4 weeks) next.

Attachments: GridHealth-MAP-v1.pdf, redwood-dedicated-sla-terms.pdf

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Sean — thanks for the summary and for sending the MOP. This matches our notes. A few clarifications from procurement and engineering: 

1) Procurement timeline: our legal and procurement typically take ~3 weeks for standard SaaS agreements and ~6 weeks for reserved/infrastructure contracts. I've attached our procurement-timeline.xlsx for visibility.
2) Security: we are SOC2 Type II in progress; we will need the security deep-dive and proof of KMS integration (customer-managed keys) before exec sign-off.
3) Capacity: the 8x A100 equivalent seems reasonable for pilot. For the pilot we prefer a non-shared pool — full isolation.

Next steps on our side: I'll share procurement contacts by EOD 6/22 and propose two windows for a security call (6/29 or 6/30). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an initial committed pricing band (monthly) and a separate consumption overage rate?

Thanks,

Anna — appreciate the quick reply and the procurement timeline. Quick answers and concrete next steps: 

Pricing & commitments (high level ranges for conversation only):
- Pilot reserved band: 2–3 month pilot commit equivalent to 8xA100 capacity: estimated $65k–$85k/month (depends on exact instance class & region).
- Production reserved bands: 6/12/24 month commit discounts available; I will include a side-by-side comparison in the formal quote.
- Overage: standard consumption rate we discussed will apply (separately metered tokens/throughput) — I'll include both per-token and per-hour overage lines.

Security / KMS: Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (we integrate with AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault). Stephanie will lead the deep-dive and can provide the SOC2 mapping doc.

Operational notes on isolation & scaling:
- We propose an initial dedicated pool with strict VPC peering and no public egress for inference nodes. Control plane telemetry can be configured to send logs to your logging endpoint or retained per your policy.
- Autoscale policy: reactive scaling with headroom for 2x burst. We can also enable scheduled scale-up during known windows.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-sla-terms.pdf (SLA + availability table) and a short one-pager on reserved-commit options.

Action items (updated):
- Sean: Deliver formal quote + SOW and commit options (by 6/24). HubSpot deal linked: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345678

- Stephanie: Schedule security deep-dive (proposed 6/29) — provide SOC2 artifacts list (by 6/25).
- Vivek: Confirm infra provisioning ETA and any blockers for full isolation (by 6/24).

If agreeable I'll initiate a DocuSign envelope for the pilot SOW as soon as procurement confirms the PO path. DocuSign preview link: https://www.docusign.com/sign?doc=GH-MOP-2026
